name: Caesar Salad with Tomatoes & Creamy Dijon Deviled Eggs
instructions: Place eggs in a medium saucepan, cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Grate Parmesan into a large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to bowl with the Parmesan.
Mince anchovy fillets and add to the bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl; add mayo, oil, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Medium dice tomato and add to the bowl with the dressing; set aside.
When the eggs are cool enough to handle, peel and halve.
Scoop out the yolks and add to a small bowl along with mayo, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Using a fork, mash to combine, creating a smooth paste.
Spoon the yolk mixture back into the eggs and sprinkle with paprika.
Chop or tear romaine leaves into bite-sized pieces, add to the bowl with the dressing, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and eggs between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
